parsed.explanation: Active traveler-facing exposure: passport/visa rules create document-appearance mismatch, refusal, stranding and possible lifetime fraud findings if officers suspect misrepresentation; a national order excludes transgender people from government-funded single-sex facilities, and state bans/criminal trespass plus one documented arrest and misgendered custody create tier-1 universal risk. State protections, courts and legal aid partly mediate but cannot offset enforced border/facility restrictions. Immigration-custody abuse claims are severe but single-sourced and uncorroborated. No trans-specific violence rate is documented; absence is not safety. Consequences if outed are severe but not catastrophic, placing this in High Risk.
